meta.name: convex-quickstart
meta.description: Get a barebones Convex + web template running from a one-sentence idea.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用一句话想法生成可运行的 Convex 网页模板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想快速开始一个 Convex 应用开发，希望有基础模板直接上手。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a one-line idea into a runnable Convex web template.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to kick off a Convex app quickly with a ready-made template.

howto.what: 当你说出一个想法,Claude 会为你搭建一个极简的 Next.js + Convex 网页模板,在本地运行并打开页面。如果环境无法运行,它会直接生成 Convex 后端项目代码。
howto.when: 当用户用一句话描述想法,并要求搭建一个可运行的 Convex 网页项目时触发。

say.text: 用一句话想法搭 Convex 模板:一个待办事项应用。
say.note: Claude 会开始搭建并运行模板。

say.text: 快速建个 Next.js + Convex 极简项目,想法是记账网页。
say.note: 它会创建项目并打开页面。

say.text: 只写 Convex 后端代码,不跑起来,想法是投票应用。
say.note: 这会触发降级规则,直接生成代码。

howto.what_en: Claude builds a minimal Next.js + Convex template from your one-sentence idea, runs it locally, and opens the dev URL. If it can't run, it writes a standard Convex project directly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user gives a one-sentence idea and asks for a runnable Convex web project.

say_en.text: Set up a Convex template from this idea: a todo app.
say_en.note: Claude will start building and run it.

say_en.text: Quickly build a minimal Next.js + Convex project for a budget page.
say_en.note: It will create the project and open the page.

say_en.text: Just write the Convex backend code, don't run it, idea: a voting app.
say_en.note: This triggers the degradation rule and generates code directly.
